decisions.positive_evidence: Separate behavior-control purpose from broad refusal removal. Publisher reports Chinese political censorship reduction while retaining most harmful-request refusals; Q4 variant and source SHA256 metadata available.
decisions.negative_evidence: Publisher-only evidence; training/edit method undisclosed. 2 of 115 sensitive questions excluded using knowledge probes. GPQA/IFBench use official-card baselines, not matched reruns. General capability and harmful-request tests are BF16, not Q4. All tests text-only; no independent truthfulness or multilingual validation.
decisions.incumbent_comparison: Existing OrcaRouter/0bserverx broad refusal edits and Pantheon RP SFT do not demonstrate this selective behavior profile. Retain official Qwen3.8 and Nanbeige controls; do not add BF16+FP8+GGUF as separate capabilities.
decisions.next_validation: Resolve full immutable SHA, record training/edit method if author supplies it; blinded complete 115+30 Chinese question evaluation, Japanese/English transfer, truthfulness, harmless overrefusal, harmful refusal and task quality on the actual Q4 build.
decisions.reversal_condition: Move to HOLD if behavior is explained by factual errors or general quality loss; reject duplicate capability if an incumbent matches selective behavior under the same tests.
